questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this API maps its operations onto HTTP methods and resources? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client POSTs a valid appointment for a provider and time that already hold a non-cancelled booking. What does the client receive?
choices: 500, because the store throws and the router does not catch it
201 with the existing appointment's representation, since creation is idempotent per slot
409 with an application/problem+json body describing the unavailable slot
422, because the request body failed validation

questions.prompt: A client lists appointments with GET /v1/appointments?limit=1000. What happens?
choices: Up to 100 items are returned, with a next link when more rows remain
All matching rows are returned in a single page
20 items are returned, the default, ignoring the larger value
400 is returned because the limit exceeds the maximum

questions.prompt: Two clients read the same appointment (ETag "1"). Client A reschedules it with If-Match: "1" and succeeds. Client B then sends its own reschedule with If-Match: "1". What does B get?
choices: 404, because the old representation no longer exists
412 with a problem document, because the ETag no longer matches
